fields.title: Columns
fields.description: Select all columns containing the projected data.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove selected columns
fields.description: If checked, the selected columns are removed in the output table.

fields.title: Fail if missing values are encountered
fields.description:
If checked, execution fails when the selected columns contain missing values. By default, rows with missing
values are ignored and excluded from the computation.
